connector.name: HackMD
connector.registryDescription: A Model Context Protocol server for integrating HackMD's note-taking platform with AI assistants.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package hackmd-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yuna0x0 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
